about_the_game:
FG Handout Kit Art Pack




The FG Handout Kit Art Pack features images and art produced by our in-house artist, Joshua Watmough. They have been organized and optimized for use with Fantasy Grounds VTT and the image tools. This art pack consists of images that can be used to create typical fantasy-style handouts. This pack consists of different scrolls, parchment, books, and so on, to be collaged together to create custom and interesting handouts. This pack includes the following items:





    Brushes of torn parchment edges, borders, and more
  • Background images of books, spirit boards, parchment, and more
  • Fills include several textures, paper, parchments, and more
" Adapted for Fantasy Grounds by: Joshua Watmough
